items.title: Plex媒体服务器URL未中和致插件调用
items.title_zh: Plex媒体服务器URL未中和致插件调用
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过searchOne未中和URL调用其他插件函数并注入参数，可能滥用插件功能
items.repro_note: 向searchOne传入未中和URL，调用其他插件并自带参数
items.impact_scope: 媒体服务器，可能暴露公网或内网
items.description: Plex Media Server before 1.43.3.10861 does not correctly neutralize URL values included in 'searchOne,' allowing an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters.

items.title: Plex媒体服务器转码路径SSRF
items.summary_zh: 已认证用户经转码接口path参数请求任意内外部地址，探测内网或访问敏感服务
items.impact_scope: 媒体服务器，可作内网探测跳板
items.description: Plex Media Server before 1.43.3.10861 allows an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter.

items.title: Plex媒体服务器时间线SSRF
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用任意X-Plex-Token经timeline的protocol参数令服务器POST任意URL
items.impact_scope: 媒体服务器，可被用于内网请求转发
items.description: Plex Media Server before 1.43.3.10861 allows SSRF via '/player/timeline'. An attacker using any X-Plex-Token value can include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination.

items.title: SiteGuard服务器命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可利用命令注入在SiteGuard运行主机以root或SYSTEM权限执行任意OS命令
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本或联系厂商获取补丁
items.repro_note: 入口未披露，需审计SiteGuard命令注入点并验证root/SYSTEM执行
items.impact_scope: 安全服务器软件，常部署于内网或公网
items.description: SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability, which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

items.title: Plex管理员任意文件写入致代码执行
items.title_zh: Plex管理员任意文件写入致代码执行
items.summary_zh: 管理员可通过TranscoderH264Options写入任意文件，重启加载恶意.so执行代码
items.repro_note: 管理员设置TranscoderH264Options写.so到加载目录后重启
items.impact_scope: 媒体服务器，管理员权限后可持久化控制
items.description: Plex Media Server before 1.43.3.10861 allows an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. The preference TranscoderH264Options is appended verbatim to x264's option string on every transcode. At startup, all .so files are run without signature, execute bit, or symbol checks.

items.title: 西门子软件中心DLL搜索路径劫持
items.title_zh: 西门子软件中心DLL搜索路径劫持
items.summary_zh: 本地已认证攻击者可在搜索路径放置恶意DLL，诱使应用加载并以应用权限执行代码
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需高权限)
items.description: A vulnerability has been identified in Siemens Software Center (All versions < V4.0.9.8). The affected application loads dynamic-link libraries (DLLs) from an uncontrolled search path. This could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

items.title: Wavlink路由器命令注入未授权RCE
items.title_zh: Wavlink路由器命令注入未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程未授权攻击者伪造IP-FROM头绕过登录，经ovpn_file的file_id注入命令并以root执行
items.action_zh: 升级至修复固件，或限制受影响管理接口
items.repro_note: 伪造IP-FROM头访问/protocol.csp，向file_id注入命令
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: Wavlink WL-WN530BE1-A firmware through M30BE1_V251117 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the sub_23B54 function of the ioos binary, which passes the unsanitized file_id parameter of /protocol.csp?opt=ovpn_file requests with type=del to popen(). A remote unauthenticated attacker can send a forged IP-FROM: 127.0.0.1 header to bypass login and execute arbitrary commands as root.

items.title: Froxlor统计符号链接致root提权
items.summary_zh: 已认证客户可将统计目录替换为符号链接，借root cron chown获取任意目录所有权并提权
items.repro_note: 认证客户将文档根统计目录替换为符号链接，等待root cron执行chown
items.impact_scope: 主机控制面板，低权客户可提权至root
items.description: Froxlor before 2.3.15 contains a symlink following vulnerability in Statistics::makeChownWithNewStats that allows authenticated customers to take ownership of arbitrary host directories by abusing the root-run traffic cron. Attackers can replace the goaccess statistics directory in their document root with a symlink, causing chown -R to hand root-owned trees to them and enabling root escalation.

items.title: 未知组件参数命令注入RCE
items.title_zh: 未知组件参数命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可操纵sfile/dfile/access/user参数触发OS命令注入，执行任意命令并控制主机
items.action_zh: 定位受影响组件并升级至修复版本
items.repro_note: 操纵sfile/dfile/access/user参数验证命令注入
items.impact_scope: 影响面未知，需按资产清单排查
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in aaPanel up to 8.25.0. The affected element is the function ExecShell of the file class/public/common.py of the component File Manager. The manipulation of the argument sfile/dfile/access/user leads to os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor confirms: "The reported RCE and LFI vulnerabilities require authentication."

items.title: Argo CD仓库服务路径遍历
items.title_zh: Argo CD仓库服务路径遍历
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用绝对路径、父目录或符号链接读取repo-server可读文件，泄露环境变量、令牌和私钥
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，限制repo-server文件访问权限
items.repro_note: 经绝对路径、../或仓库符号链接读取/proc/self/environ等文件
items.impact_scope: Kubernetes交付组件，凭据泄露可横向
items.description: Absolute paths, parent-directory traversal, and repository symlinks can open any file readable by the repo-server, including /proc/self/environ, projected service-account tokens, mounted private keys, and repository credentials. An attacker can commit a .jsonnet file to a Git repository used by an Application or upload the file through POST /api/v1/applications/manifestsWithFiles, also exposed by argocd app diff --local --server-side-generate.

items.title: Argo CD仓库服务参数注入RCE
items.title_zh: Argo CD仓库服务参数注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者经Kustomization或上传接口注入--upload-pack，在repo-server执行命令
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，禁用file://本地传输
items.description: A leading-hyphen value can be parsed as --upload-pack and execute a command inside argocd-repo-server when the remote uses a local transport such as file://. An attacker can commit a Kustomization to a Git repository that an Application builds or upload files through POST /api/v1/applications/manifestsWithFiles, also exposed by argocd app diff --local --server-side-generate.

items.title: Argo CD Helm插件自动加载RCE
items.title_zh: Argo CD Helm插件自动加载RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用恶意helmCharts仓库URL触发Helm自动加载下载插件，在repo-server执行命令
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，禁用不可信Helm下载插件
items.repro_note: 配置helmCharts的插件协议URL，使Helm自动加载并执行插件
items.description: Helm automatically loads a downloader plugin from `<configHome>/.data/plugins` without a separate plugin-install step and executes its program inside argocd-repo-server when a helmCharts repository URL uses the plugin's protocol. An attacker can commit the Kustomization and plugin to a Git repository that an Application builds or upload the files through POST /api/v1/applications/manifestsWithFiles, also exposed by argocd app diff --local --server-side-generate.

items.title: Kiro Crew群组越权致RCE
items.summary_zh: 已加入运营者配置WhatsApp群组的远程成员可越权控制其他Agent会话并在主机执行命令
items.repro_note: 以WhatsApp群成员发送消息，越权控制Agent会话并执行主机命令
items.impact_scope: AI Agent主机，群成员可横向控制
items.description: Missing authorization in the WhatsApp group channel in Kiro Crew might allow a remote actor who is a member of an operator-configured WhatsApp group to control the operator's other agent sessions and execute arbitrary commands on the host running Kiro Crew via messages sent to the group. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 0.7.2.
